parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required when you authenticate by using an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK/SK) or a Security Token Service (STS) temporary credential.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can get this ID from your organization's URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example, https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}.
